digest.component_or_area: reconciler outbound differ and adapter seam
propositions: The outbound differ compares fields in vendor (Jira) shape while the inbound differ canonicalizes to local shape before comparing, creating asymmetry that violates ADR 0035 port seam principles.

The outbound update path must canonicalize the snapshot via the injected InboundMapper, diff in local field names, and emit vendor payloads only via a new OutboundMapper.map_fields_to_remote() method at the emission boundary.

Core field-comparison helpers must become vendor-agnostic (consuming only canonical field names) while vendor-specific mapping and resolution logic (assignee resolver, identity matching) relocates to the OutboundMapper as adapter-internal.

The InboundMapper output must be extended with three new canonical keys (assignee_identity, remote_parent_id, reporter_identity) that tolerate partial/absent vendor keys without defaulting, preserving arbitration equivalence with vendor-shaped stored baselines.

Field comparison via canonicalized snapshot and baseline must preserve decision-for-decision equivalence with the prior vendor-space comparison across all status/priority maps, assignee shapes, labels, descriptions, and resolver fallback paths.
